verses.geez: ጠባባት፡ አንስት፡ ሐነፃ፡ አብያተ፡ ወዐብዳትሰ፡ ነሠታ፡ አብያቲሆን፡ በእደዊሆን።
verses.translation: Wise women build houses: but a foolish one digs hers down with her hands.

translations.lxx: Wise women build houses: but a foolish one digs hers down with her hands.
translations.kjv: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
translations.ron: Femeile înţelepte zidesc casa, iar cele nebune o dărâmă cu mâna lor.
translations.grk: Σοφαὶ γυναῖκες ᾠκοδόμησαν οἴκους, ἡ δὲ ἄφρων κατέσκαψε ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ዘየሐውር፡ ፍኖተ፡ ርቱዐ፡ ይፈርሆ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወዘሰ፡ ያጠዊ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ ይትሜነን።
verses.translation: He that walks uprightly fears the Lord; but he that is perverse in his ways shall be dishonoured.

translations.lxx: He that walks uprightly fears the Lord; but he that is perverse in his ways shall be dishonoured.
translations.kjv: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
translations.ron: Cel ce umblă întru dreptate se teme de Domnul, iar cel ce umblă pe căi strâmbe îl dispreţuieşte.
translations.grk: Ὁ πορευόμενος ὀρθῶς φοβεῖται τὸν Κύριον, ὁ δὲ σκολιάζων ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ ἀτιμασθήσεται.

verses.geez: እምአፈ፡ ዐብዳን፡ ይወፅእ፡ በትረ፡ ጽእለት፡ ወከናፍረ፡ ጠቢባንሰ፡ ተዓቅቦሙ።
verses.translation: Out of the mouth of fools comes a rod of pride; but the lips of the wise preserve them.

translations.lxx: Out of the mouth of fools comes a rod of pride; but the lips of the wise preserve them.
translations.kjv: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
translations.ron: În gura celui nebun este varga mândriei lui; buzele pe cei înţelepţi îi păzesc.
translations.grk: Ἐκ στόματος ἀφρόνων βακτηρία ὕβρεως, χείλη δὲ σοφῶν φυλάσσει αὐτούς.

verses.geez: ወእደ፡ አልቦ፡ አልሕምት፡ ምጽንጋዕ፡ ንጹሕ፡ ወእደሰ፡ ብዙኅ፡ እክል፡ ይትዓወቅ፡ እምኃይለ፡ ላሕሙ።
verses.translation: Where no oxen are, the cribs are clean; but where there is abundant produce, the strength of the ox is apparent.

translations.lxx: Where no oxen are, the cribs are clean; but where there is abundant produce, the strength of the ox is apparent.
translations.kjv: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
translations.ron: Unde nu sunt boi, staulul este gol, însă puterea boilor aduce mult folos.
translations.grk: Οὗ μή εἰσι βόες, φάτναι καθαραί· οὗ δὲ πολλὰ γεννήματα, φανερὰ βοὸς ἰσχύς.

verses.geez: ስምዐ፡ መሃይምናን፡ ኢይሔሱ፡ ወያነድድ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ሰማዕተ፡ ሐሰት።
verses.translation: A faithful witness does not lie; but an unjust witness kindles falsehoods.

translations.lxx: A faithful witness does not lie; but an unjust witness kindles falsehoods.
translations.kjv: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
translations.ron: Martorul care grăieşte adevărul nu minte, iar martorul mincinos spune numai minciuni.
translations.grk: Μάρτυς πιστὸς οὐ ψεύδεται, ἐκκαίει δὲ ψευδῆ μάρτυς ἄδικος.

verses.geez: ተኃሥሣ፡ ለጥበብ፡ በኀበ፡ እኩያን፡ ወኢትረክባ፡ ወአእምሮሰ፡ በኀበ፡ ጠቢባን፡ ቀሊል።
verses.translation: Thou shalt seek wisdom with bad men, and shalt not find it; but discretion is easily available with the prudent.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt seek wisdom with bad men, and shalt not find it; but discretion is easily available with the prudent.
translations.kjv: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
translations.ron: Batjocoritorul caută înţelepciunea şi nu o găseşte, iar pentru cel priceput ştiinţa este uşoară.
translations.grk: Ζητήσεις σοφίαν παρὰ κακοῖς καὶ οὐχ εὑρήσεις, αἴσθησις δὲ παρὰ φρονίμοις εὐχερής.

verses.geez: ኵሉ፡ ርቱዕ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ዐብድ፡ ወወልታ፡ አእምሮ፡ ከናፍረ፡ ጠቢባን።
verses.translation: All things are adverse to a foolish man; but wise lips are the weapons of discretion.

translations.lxx: All things are adverse to a foolish man; but wise lips are the weapons of discretion.
translations.kjv: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
translations.ron: Fugi dinaintea omului fără de minte, căci tu ştii că nu este nici o ştiinţă pe buzele lui.
translations.grk: Πάντα ἐναντία ἀνδρὶ ἄφρονι, ὅπλα δὲ αἰσθήσεως χείλη σοφά.

verses.geez: ጥበብ፡ ለማእምራን፡ ተአምር፡ ፍኖቶሙ፡ ወለእለ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ልብሰ፡ ውስተ፡ ስሒት፡ ይከውን፡ ፍኖቶሙ።
verses.translation: The wisdom of the prudent will understand their ways; but the folly of fools leads astray.

translations.lxx: The wisdom of the prudent will understand their ways; but the folly of fools leads astray.
translations.kjv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea omului chibzuit este de a-şi înţelege calea lui; iar nebunia celor neînţelepţi este înşelăciune.
translations.grk: Σοφία πανούργων ἐπιγνώσεται τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν, ἄνοια δὲ ἀφρόνων ἐν πλάνῃ.

verses.geez: አብያቲሆሙ፡ ለኃጥአን፡ ይፈድዩ፡ ለንጹሐን፡ ወአብያተ፡ ጻድቃንሰ፡ ሥሙር።
verses.translation: The houses of transgressors will need purification; but the houses of the just are acceptable.

translations.lxx: The houses of transgressors will need purification; but the houses of the just are acceptable.
translations.kjv: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
translations.ron: Nebunul îşi bate joc de jertfa pentru păcat, însă între oamenii drepţi este bună înţelegere.
translations.grk: Οἰκίαι παρανόμων ὀφειλήσουσι καθαρισμὸν, οἰκίαι δὲ δικαίων δεκταί.

verses.geez: ልበ፡ ብእሲ፡ ማእምር፡ ኀዘን፡ ለነፍሱ፡ ወሶበሂ፡ ይትፌሣሕ፡ ኢይትሐወሶ፡ ጽልእ።
verses.translation: If a man's mind is intelligent, his soul is sorrowful; and when he rejoices, he has no fellowship with pride.

translations.lxx: If a man's mind is intelligent, his soul is sorrowful; and when he rejoices, he has no fellowship with pride.
translations.kjv: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
translations.ron: Inima cunoaşte amărăciunile sale, iar un străin nu poate împărţi bucuriile ei.
translations.grk: Καρδία ἀνδρὸς αἰσθητικὴ, λυπηρὰ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ, ὅταν δὲ εὐφραίνηται οὐκ ἐπιμίγνυται ὕβρει.

verses.geez: አብያተ፡ ረሲዐን፡ ይማስኑ፡ ወማኅደረ፡ ራትዓንሰ፡ ይቀውም።
verses.translation: The houses of ungodly men shall be utterly destroyed; but the tabernacles of them that walk uprightly shall stand.

translations.lxx: The houses of ungodly men shall be utterly destroyed; but the tabernacles of them that walk uprightly shall stand.
translations.kjv: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
translations.ron: Casa celor fără de lege va fi distrusă, iar cortul celor drepţi va înflori.
translations.grk: Οἰκίαι ἀσεβῶν ἀφανισθήσονται, σκηναὶ δὲ κατορθούντων στήσονται.

verses.geez: ቦ፡ ፍኖት፡ እንተ፡ ትመስል፡ ርትዕተ፡ በኀበ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወደ፡ ኃሪታሰ፡ ታበጽሕ፡ ውስተ፡ ማዕምቅተ፡ ሲኦል።
verses.translation: There is a way which seems to be right with men, but the ends of it reach to the depth of hell.

translations.lxx: There is a way which seems to be right with men, but the ends of it reach to the depth of hell.
translations.kjv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
translations.ron: Unele căi par drepte în ochii omului, dar sfârşitul lor sunt căile morţii.
translations.grk: Ἔστιν ὁδὸς ἣ δοκεῖ παρὰ ἀνθρώποις ὀρθὴ εἶναι, τὰ δὲ τελευταῖα αὐτῆς ἔρχεται εἰς πυθμένα ᾅδου.

verses.geez: ውስተ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ ኢይዴመር፡ ኃዘን፡ ደኃሪታሰ፡ ለፍሥሓ፡ ውስተ፡ ላህ፡ ትገብእ።
verses.translation: Grief mingles not with mirth; and joy in the end comes to grief.

translations.lxx: Grief mingles not with mirth; and joy in the end comes to grief.
translations.kjv: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
translations.ron: Chiar când râdem, inima se întristează; bucuria se sfârşeşte prin plângere.
translations.grk: Ἐν εὐφροσύναις οὐ προσμίγνυται λύπη, τελευταῖα δὲ χαρὰ εἰς πένθος ἔρχεται.

verses.geez: እምፍኖተ፡ ዚአሁ፡ ይመልእ፡ ዕቡየ፡ ልብ፡ ወብእሲ፡ ኄር፡ እምሕሊናሁ፡ ይመልእ፡ በረከተ።
verses.translation: A stout-hearted man shall be filled with his own ways; and a good man with his own thoughts.

translations.lxx: A stout-hearted man shall be filled with his own ways; and a good man with his own thoughts.
translations.kjv: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
translations.ron: Nelegiuitul se va sătura de căile sale şi omul bun de roadele sale.
translations.grk: Τῶν ἑαυτοῦ ὁδῶν πλησθήσεται θρασυκάρδιος, ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν διανοημάτων αὐτοῦ ἀνὴρ ἀγαθός.

verses.geez: የዋህ፡ የአምን፡ ኵሎ፡ ነገረ፡ ማእምር፡ ባሕቱ፡ ይገብእ፡ ውስተ፡ ንስሓ።
verses.translation: The simple believes every word: but the prudent man betakes himself to after-thought.

translations.lxx: The simple believes every word: but the prudent man betakes himself to after-thought.
translations.kjv: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
translations.ron: Omul simplu crede toate vorbele; omul înţelept veghează paşii săi.
translations.grk: Ἄκακος πιστεύει παντὶ λόγῳ, πανοῦργος δὲ ἔρχεται εἰς μετάνοιαν.

verses.geez: ጠቢብ፡ ፈሪሖ፡ ተግኅሠ፡ እምአኩይ፡ ወዐብድሰ፡ ተአሚኖ፡ ርእሶ፡ ይጸመር፡ ምስለ፡ ዐብዳን።
verses.translation: A wise man fears, and departs from evil; but the fool trusts in himself, and joins himself with the transgressor.

translations.lxx: A wise man fears, and departs from evil; but the fool trusts in himself, and joins himself with the transgressor.
translations.kjv: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
translations.ron: Înţeleptul se teme şi se fereşte de rău, iar cel fără de minte îşi iese din fire şi se simte la adăpost.
translations.grk: Σοφὸς φοβηθεὶς ἐξέκλινεν ἀπὸ κακοῦ, ὁ δὲ ἄφρων ἑαυτῷ πεποιθὼς μίγνυται ἀνόμῳ.

verses.geez: መዓትም፡ ይገብር፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ምክር፡ ብእሲሰ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ይትዔገሥ።
verses.translation: A passionate man acts inconsiderately; but a sensible man bears up under many things.

translations.lxx: A passionate man acts inconsiderately; but a sensible man bears up under many things.
translations.kjv: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
translations.ron: Cel iute la mânie săvârşeşte nebunii, iar cel cumpănit se stăpâneşte.
translations.grk: Ὀξύθυμος πράσσει μετὰ ἀβουλίας, ἀνὴρ δὲ φρόνιμος πολλὰ ὑποφέρει.

verses.geez: ይትካፈሉ፡ ዓብዳን፡ እከየ፡ ማእምራንሰ፡ ይእኅዝዎ፡ ለጠይቆ።
verses.translation: Fools shall have mischief for their portion; but the prudent shall take fast hold of understanding.

translations.lxx: Fools shall have mischief for their portion; but the prudent shall take fast hold of understanding.
translations.kjv: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
translations.ron: Cei nepricepuţi au parte de nebunie, pe când cei înţelepţi sunt încununaţi cu ştiinţă.
translations.grk: Μεριοῦνται ἄφρονες κακίαν, οἱ δὲ πανοῦργοι κρατήσουσιν αἰσθήσεως.

verses.geez: ይድኅፁ፡ እኩያን፡ በቅድመ፡ ኄራን፡ ወረሲዓንሰ፡ ይትቀነዩ፡ በኆኅተ፡ ጻድቃን።
verses.translation: Evil men shall fall before the good; and the ungodly shall attend at the gates of the righteous.

translations.lxx: Evil men shall fall before the good; and the ungodly shall attend at the gates of the righteous.
translations.kjv: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
translations.ron: Cei răi se pleacă înaintea celor buni şi cei nelegiuiţi stau la porţile celor drepţi.
translations.grk: Ὀλισθήσουσι κακοὶ ἔναντι ἀγαθῶν, καὶ ἀσεβεῖς θεραπεύσουσι θύρας δικαίων.

verses.geez: አዕርክተ፡ አብዕልት፡ ይጸልኡ፡ አዕርክተ፡ ነዳያን፡ አዕርክተ፡ አብዕልትሰ፡ ብዙኀን።
verses.translation: Friends will hate poor friends; but the friends of the rich are many.

translations.lxx: Friends will hate poor friends; but the friends of the rich are many.
translations.kjv: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
translations.ron: Săracul este dispreţuit chiar şi de prietenul lui, pe când prietenii celui bogat sunt fără de număr.
translations.grk: Φίλοι μισήσουσι φίλους πτωχούς, φίλοι δὲ πλουσίων πολλοί.

verses.geez: ዘይሜንኖ፡ ለነዳይ፡ ይነዲ፡ ወዘይምሕሮሰ፡ ለፅኑስ፡ ብፁዕ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: He that dishonours the needy sins: but he that has pity on the poor is most blessed.

translations.lxx: He that dishonours the needy sins: but he that has pity on the poor is most blessed.
translations.kjv: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
translations.ron: Cel care nu bagă în seamă pe prietenul său săvârşeşte un păcat; iar cel ce se îndură de sărmani e fericit.
translations.grk: Ὁ ἀτιμάζων πένητας ἁμαρτάνει, ἐλεῶν δὲ πτωχοὺς μακαριστός.

verses.geez: ስሑታን፡ ይሔልዩ፡ እከየ፡ ወሣህለ፡ ወጽድቀ፡ ይሔልዩ፡ ኄራን፡ ወኢየአምሩ፡ ሣህለ፡ ወምሕረተ፡ ጸረብተ፡ እኪት።
verses.translation: They that go astray devise evils: but the good devise mercy and truth. The framers of evil do not understand mercy and truth: but compassion and faithfulness are with the framers of good.

translations.lxx: They that go astray devise evils: but the good devise mercy and truth. The framers of evil do not understand mercy and truth: but compassion and faithfulness are with the framers of good.
translations.kjv: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
translations.ron: Cu adevărat rătăcesc cei ce plănuiesc fărădelegea, iar cei ce cugetă la lucruri bune au parte de milostivire şi de adevăr.
translations.grk: Πλανώμενοι τεκταίνουσι κακά, ἔλεον δὲ καὶ ἀλήθειαν τεκταίνουσιν ἀγαθοί· οὐκ ἐπίστανται ἔλεον καὶ πίστιν τέκτονες κακῶν, ἐλεημοσύναι δὲ καὶ πίστεις παρὰ τέκτοσιν ἀγαθοῖς.

verses.geez: ምሕረት፡ ባሕቱ፡ ወሃይማኖት፡ ኀበ፡ ጸረብት፡ ኄራን፡ በኵሉ፡ ሕሊና፡ ትሩፍ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወላህይሰ፡ ዘኢየሐምም፡ ፅኑስ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: With every one who is careful there is abundance: but the pleasure-taking and indolent shall be in want.

translations.lxx: With every one who is careful there is abundance: but the pleasure-taking and indolent shall be in want.
translations.kjv: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
translations.ron: Orice osteneală duce la îndestulare, iar cuvintele fără rost la lipsă.
translations.grk: Ἐν παντὶ μεριμνῶντι ἔνεστι περισσόν, ὁ δὲ ἡδὺς καὶ ἀνάλγητος ἐν ἐνδείᾳ ἔσται.

verses.geez: አክሊሎሙ፡ ለጠቢባን፡ ማእምር፡ ወመምህሮሙ፡ ለዐብዳን፡ እኩይ።
verses.translation: A prudent man is the crown of the wise: but the occupation of fools is evil.

translations.lxx: A prudent man is the crown of the wise: but the occupation of fools is evil.
translations.kjv: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
translations.ron: Bogăţia este o cunună pentru cei înţelepţi; iar coroana color nebuni este nebunia.
translations.grk: Στέφανος σοφῶν πανοῦργος, ἡ δὲ διατριβὴ ἀφρόνων κακή.

verses.geez: ያድኅን፡ ነፍሶ፡ እምእኩይ፡ ሰማዕት፡ ማእምር፡ ወያነድድ፡ ባሕቱ፡ በሐሰት፡ ሰማዕት፡ መዓምዕ።
verses.translation: A faithful witness shall deliver a soul from evil: but a deceitful man kindles falsehoods.

translations.lxx: A faithful witness shall deliver a soul from evil: but a deceitful man kindles falsehoods.
translations.kjv: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
translations.ron: Martorul drept scapă suflete, iar cel viclean spune numai minciuni.
translations.grk: Ῥύσεται ἐκ κακῶν ψυχὴν μάρτυς πιστὸς, ἐκκαίει δὲ ψευδῆ δόλιος.

verses.geez: በፍርሃተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ተስፋ፡ ኃያል፡ ወየኀድግ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ጽንዐ።
verses.translation: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: and he leaves his children a support.

translations.lxx: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: and he leaves his children a support.
translations.kjv: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
translations.ron: Întru frica lui Dumnezeu este nădejdea celui tare; fiii lui afla-vor (acolo) un liman.
translations.grk: Ἐν φόβῳ Κυρίου ἐλπὶς ἰσχύος, τοῖς δὲ τέκνοις αὐτοῦ καταλείπει ἔρεισμα.

verses.geez: ትእዛዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ነቅዐ፡ ሕይወት፡ ወይሬሲ፡ ከመ፡ ይትገኃሡ፡ እመሥገርተ፡ ሞት።
verses.translation: The commandment of the Lord is a fountain of life; and it causes men to turn aside from the snare of death.

translations.lxx: The commandment of the Lord is a fountain of life; and it causes men to turn aside from the snare of death.
translations.kjv: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
translations.ron: Frica de Dumnezeu este un izvor de viaţă, ca să putem scăpa de cursele morţii.
translations.grk: Πρόσταγμα Κυρίου πηγὴ ζωῆς, ποιεῖ δὲ ἐκκλίνειν ἐκ παγίδος θανάτου.

verses.geez: በብዝኀ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ክብሩ፡ ለንጉሥ፡ ወበውኅደተ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ድቀቱ፡ ለመኰንን።
verses.translation: In a populous nation is the glory of a king: but in the failure of people is the ruin of a prince.

translations.lxx: In a populous nation is the glory of a king: but in the failure of people is the ruin of a prince.
translations.kjv: In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
translations.ron: Strălucirea unui rege se sprijină pe mulţimea poporului, iar lipsa de supuşi este pieirea prinţului.
translations.grk: Ἐν πολλῷ ἔθνει δόξα βασιλέως, ἐν δὲ ἐκλείψει λαοῦ συντριβὴ δυνάστου.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ ነዊኅ፡ መንፈስ፡ ወርኂበ፡ ልብ፡ ጠቢበ፡ ይከውን።
verses.translation: A man slow to wrath abounds in wisdom: but a man of impatient spirit is very foolish.

translations.lxx: A man slow to wrath abounds in wisdom: but a man of impatient spirit is very foolish.
translations.kjv: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
translations.ron: Cel încet la mânie este bogat în înţelepciune, iar cel ce se mânie degrabă îşi dă pe faţă nebunia.
translations.grk: Μακρόθυμος ἀνὴρ πολὺς ἐν φρονήσει, ὁ δὲ ὀλιγόψυχος ἰσχυρῶς ἄφρων.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ መስተዐግሥ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ጠቢበ፡ ይከውን፡ ወኅፀፀ፡ ነፍስሰ፡ ፅኑስ፡ ዓብድ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: A meek-spirited man is a healer of the heart: but a sensitive heart is a corruption of the bones.

translations.lxx: A meek-spirited man is a healer of the heart: but a sensitive heart is a corruption of the bones.
translations.kjv: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
translations.ron: O inimă fără patimă este viaţa trupului, pe când pornirea pătimaşă este ca un cariu în oase.
translations.grk: Πρᾳΰθυμος ἀνὴρ καρδίας ἰατρὸς, σὴς δὲ ὀστέων καρδία αἰσθητική·

verses.geez: አራቂ፡ ብእሲ፡ መፈውሰ፡ ልብ፡ ከመ፡ ነቀዝ፡ ለአዕፅምት፡ ቅንአት፡ ወትዝኅርት፡ እኩይ፡ ለልብ፡ ማእምር።
verses.translation: He that oppresses the needy provokes his Maker: but he that honours him has pity upon the poor.

translations.lxx: He that oppresses the needy provokes his Maker: but he that honours him has pity upon the poor.
translations.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
translations.ron: Cel care apasă pe cel sărman defaimă pe Ziditorul lui, dar cel ce are milă de sărac Îl cinsteşte.
translations.grk: Ὁ συκοφαντῶν πένητα παροξύνει τὸν ποιήσαντα αὐτὸν, ὁ δὲ τιμῶν αὐτὸν ἐλεεῖ πτωχόν.

verses.geez: ዘይትዔገል፡ ነዳየ፡ ይዌህኮ፡ ለፈጣሪሁ፡ ወዘያከብሮሰ፡ ይምሕር፡ ነዳየ።
verses.translation: The ungodly shall be driven away in his wickedness: but he who is secure in his own holiness is just.

translations.lxx: The ungodly shall be driven away in his wickedness: but he who is secure in his own holiness is just.
translations.kjv: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
translations.ron: Cel fără de lege este răsturnat de răutatea lui, iar cel drept găseşte scăpare în neprihănirea lui.
translations.grk: Ἐν κακίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἀπωσθήσεται ἀσεβής, ὁ δὲ πεποιθὼς τῇ ἑαυτοῦ ὁσιότητι δίκαιος.

verses.geez: በእከዩ፡ ይትአተት፡ ረሲዕ፡ ወዘይትአመንሰ፡ ኂሩቶ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: There is wisdom in the good heart of a man: but in the heart of fools it is not discerned.

translations.lxx: There is wisdom in the good heart of a man: but in the heart of fools it is not discerned.
translations.kjv: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea sălăşluieşte în inima celui înţelept, iar în inima celor nebuni nu se arată.
translations.grk: Ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀγαθῇ ἀνδρὸς σοφία, ἐν δὲ καρδίᾳ ἀφρόνων οὐ διαγινώσκεται.

verses.geez: ውስተ፡ ልበ፡ ኄር፡ ተዓርፍ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወውስተ፡ ልበ፡ ዐብድሰ፡ ኢትትአመር።
verses.translation: Righteousness exalts a nation: but sins diminish tribes.

translations.lxx: Righteousness exalts a nation: but sins diminish tribes.
translations.kjv: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
translations.ron: Dreptatea înalţă un popor, în vreme ce păcatul este ocara popoarelor.
translations.grk: Δικαιοσύνη ὑψοῖ ἔθνος, ἐλασσονοῦσι δὲ φυλὰς ἁμαρτίαι.

verses.geez: ጽድቅ፡ ታሌዕል፡ ሕዝበ፡ ወያሐፅፅ፡ ኃጢአት፡ ሕዝባ።
verses.translation: An understanding servant is acceptable to a king; and by his good behaviour he removes disgrace.

translations.lxx: An understanding servant is acceptable to a king; and by his good behaviour he removes disgrace.
translations.kjv: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
translations.ron: Bunăvoinţa regelui este pentru sluga înţeleaptă, iar mânia lui pentru cel ce îi face ruşine.
translations.grk: Δεκτὸς βασιλεῖ ὑπηρέτης νοήμων, τῇ δὲ ἑαυτοῦ εὐστροφίᾳ ἀφαιρεῖται ἀτιμίαν.

verses.geez: ሥሙር፡ ለንጉሥ፡ ላእክ፡ ማእምር፡ ወበተዓቅቦቱ፡ ያርኅቅ፡ ኃሣረ፡ እምነፍሱ፡ ወመዓት፡ ታኃጒል፡ ጠቢባነ።
